description: LongMemEval session/turn retrieval and knowledge-update currentness profile with no-memory, lexical-overlap, and governed Agent Memory arms, plus externally registered memory systems scored by the same evaluator under a frozen same-harness lane (#640). Retrieval and currentness evidence only; the upstream model-judged QA evaluator is not run.

source_rights.attribution: LongMemEval (Wu et al.); retrieval scoring semantics replicated from src/retrieval/run_retrieval.py and src/retrieval/eval_utils.py at the pinned revision
source_rights.acquisition_notes: Operators obtain the cleaned dataset from huggingface.co/datasets/xiaowu0162/longmemeval-cleaned at the recorded revision; the runner hashes the raw file bytes it reads. Without --input the runner uses the synthetic smoke fixture, which is not external evidence.

selection.identity_rule: input.selection.question_ids_sha256 = sha256 of newline-joined selected question ids, in source order
methods: sha256(seed || NUL || question_id) ascending; first N; source order preserved

native_metrics.description: k in {1,3,5,10,30,50}: any gold session/turn within top-k
k in {1,3,5,10,30,50}: all gold sessions/turns within top-k
k in {1,3,5,10,30,50}: upstream DCG with ranks 1 and 2 weighted equally (known insensitivity)
headline retrieval metrics restricted to knowledge-update questions
profile-local currentness diagnostic: latest-dated gold ranked first on multi-date knowledge-update questions
runtime_error, ingestion refusal, out-of-corpus, and unmapped-admission counts

native_artifacts.description: planes[granularity].backends[backend] aggregates, by_question_type, currentness, failures, timing

runner.invocation_example: python reference/run_longmemeval.py --input <longmemeval_s_cleaned.json> --corpus-class external_frozen --output report.json; external system (lane longmemeval-s-retrieval-parity-v1): PYTHONPATH=reference python reference/run_longmemeval.py --input <longmemeval_s_cleaned.json> --corpus-class external_frozen --external-backend longmemeval_mem0_explicit_bridge:install_longmemeval_mem0_explicit_backend --backend mem0_explicit

budget.retrieval_or_context_budget: ranked candidate lists scored at k in {1,3,5,10,30,50}; no answer-generation context budget

external_backends.registration: run_longmemeval.py --external-backend MODULE:ENTRY calls ENTRY(register_external_backend); the registered identity (system_id, system_kind, exact system_revision, adapter_id, adapter_revision, configuration) is recorded under execution.external_backends and bound by the normalizer
external_backends.mem0_explicit: Mem0 OSS 2.2.1 explicit memory (reference/longmemeval_mem0_explicit_bridge.py); comparator row of lane longmemeval-s-retrieval-parity-v1

failure_semantics.description: a question-level exception is recorded as runtime_error and scores as a miss with an empty ranking; ingestion refusals are counted, not raised; every pass re-hashes the input and fails closed on digest or order drift

system_requirements.unsupported_semantics: a backend that cannot rank returns an empty ranking and is scored by the native protocol; the governance dimension is not_applicable for arms without a governed admission path, including externally registered systems

judge.note: the upstream model-judged QA evaluator is intentionally not run; official_longmemeval_qa_score is not_computed

mappings.semantics: headline k per plane (session: 5,10; turn: 5,10,50); scored questions with upstream exclusions applied
headline k per plane; upstream DCG weighting
profile-local diagnostic; not an upstream LongMemEval metric
agent_memory arm only; one tenant and scope per question
single-process local execution; denominator is question count
declared not_measured: whole-process high-water mark is not attributable to one backend
declared not_measured: per-question stores were temporary
false or unknown means the run cannot be bound to an exact committed tree

unmapped_dimensions.reasoning: not_measured: upstream model-judged QA was not run
unmapped_dimensions.evaluator_integrity: not_measured: evaluator-integrity mutation probes run separately (reference/run_benchmark_integrity_mutants.py, #518) and are not bound to a run

negative_controls.description: gold item removed from the ranking
irrelevant items inserted ahead of gold
one irrelevant item at rank 1 only
negative_controls.note: known upstream insensitivity: DCG weights ranks 1 and 2 equally; reported under known_insensitivities

negative_controls.description: gold pushed below the k cutoff
stale gold ranked above current gold; currentness diagnostic must move
abstention exclusion suppressed; denominator must change
out-of-corpus items injected; out-of-corpus count must rise with recall unchanged

evaluator_integrity.qualification_expectation: all_detected must be true except declared known insensitivities, which must be confirmed as insensitive

seed.note: seed matters only for stable subset selection; full runs are seed-free

environment_requirements: no network access required once the dataset is present

gauntlet.reason: the retrieval lane is expressible through remember/recall operation envelopes, and external systems now enter the runner through its code-registration seam (#640 lane longmemeval-s-retrieval-parity-v1); a system-neutral Gauntlet profile binding through operation envelopes is still deferred until a same-harness lane needs orchestration rather than registration

product_findings.summary: currentness ordering: anti-recency exact ties and stale-higher-score cases
default post-admission ranking below the lexical baseline
commit and recall cost grow with store size

limitations: lexical_overlap is a profile-local baseline, not an upstream BM25/dense retriever
external systems enter only by code registration in the runner's RETRIEVERS table
